title: Grievance Redressal Policy
description: How MoneyCash receives, handles, and escalates customer complaints in a fair, time-bound, and transparent manner.
registeredOffice: CREDSOLVE Technologies Private Limited, Flat No. E-2748, Gaur Siddhartham, Siddharth Vihar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh — 201009

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: MoneyCash is committed to providing a transparent, efficient, and customer-centric grievance redressal mechanism to address complaints, concerns, and disputes raised by customers.
This Grievance Redressal Policy has been established in accordance with:
- Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Digital Lending Guidelines
- Applicable laws governing financial services and customer protection
The objective of this policy is to ensure that customer grievances are handled fairly, promptly, and efficiently while maintaining transparency and accountability throughout the resolution process.

sections.title: Scope
paragraphs: - Complaints relating to services provided by MoneyCash as a Lending Service Provider (LSP)
This policy covers complaints relating to:

sections.title: Guiding Principles
paragraphs: - Complaints are handled fairly and impartially.
- Customers are treated with respect and dignity.
- Complaints are resolved within defined timelines.
- Customers are informed of complaint status.
- No customer shall face discrimination or retaliation for filing a complaint.

sections.title: Definition of Grievance
paragraphs: A grievance refers to any dissatisfaction, concern, complaint, dispute, or objection expressed by a customer regarding:
- Products or services offered through MoneyCash
- Any act or omission by MoneyCash or its authorized representatives

sections.title: Channels for Lodging Complaints
paragraphs: Customers may submit grievances through any of the following channels:
Written Communication: MoneyCash, E-2748, Gaur Siddhartham, Siddharth Vihar, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh — 201009

sections.title: Information Required for Complaint Registration
paragraphs: To facilitate timely resolution, customers should provide:
- Loan Application Number or Loan Account Number
- Customers may also authorize representatives to raise complaints on their behalf.

sections.title: Complaint Handling Process
paragraphs: - A unique complaint reference number shall be generated.
- An acknowledgement shall be sent to the customer.
- Engage the lending partner where necessary.
Additional information may be requested from the customer where required.
A final response shall be communicated to the customer containing:

sections.title: Resolution Timelines & Escalation Matrix
paragraphs: Level 1: Customers can raise a complaint by creating a support ticket by going to www.moneycash.in Our support team will respond during business hours, which are Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Level 2: In the event that the complaint remains pending at Level 1 for a period of more than 5 working days, or if the customer is not satisfied with the outcome of Level 1 resolution, the customer can mail on: support@moneycash.in

Level 3: In the event that the complaint remains pending at Level 2 for a period of more than 5 working days, or if the customer is not satisfied with the outcome of Level 2 resolution, the customer can contact grievance@moneycash.in

Level 4: In the event that the complaint remains pending at Level 3 for a period of more than 5 working days, or if the customer is not satisfied with the outcome of Level 3 resolution, the customer can contact the Regional Office of the Reserve Bank of India (or via RBI’s website www.rbi.org.in).

sections.title: Collection and Recovery Complaints
paragraphs: Complaints relating to collection activities shall receive priority handling.
Any complaint regarding recovery misconduct shall be investigated immediately.
Appropriate disciplinary action shall be taken where misconduct is established.

sections.title: Fraud Reporting
paragraphs: - Fraud-related complaints shall be treated as high priority and investigated immediately.

sections.title: Record Retention
paragraphs: Complaint records shall be retained in accordance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

sections.title: Regulatory Disclosure
paragraphs: MoneyCash acts solely as a Lending Service Provider (LSP) and facilitates loan origination and servicing on behalf of regulated lending institutions, including Aasra Inforcorp NBFC Ltd.
Loan approval, sanction, disbursement, and credit decisions remain the sole responsibility of the lending partner.
Customers retain the right to escalate unresolved complaints directly to the lending partner and subsequently to the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, where applicable.
